verdict.rationale: Cal.com's docs say it powers round-robin team scheduling, and its team event-type scheduling configuration exposes hosts with priority, weight and group assignment. Advanced settings cover a weights toggle, lead threshold and no-show calculations, and a routing trace shows the host-selection logic per booking. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how weighted/priority distribution balances load in practice, and independent or hands-on corroboration that fair distribution works as described.
